resources.string: On the next screen choose «Allow all the time», so a trip can start by itself when you get in the car.
Nothing on this phone stops a recording.
Location is turned off on this phone.
Precise location is off: a trip cannot be recorded.
Location «All the time» is off: trips will not start by themselves.
Notifications are off: you will not see the recording or the question about a draft.
Battery optimization can stop a recording while the screen is off.
Background activity of TripTrack is restricted.
Battery saver is on: the GPS may update less often.
Physical activity access is off: drives are not detected.
Nearby devices access is off: the car stereo is not recognised.
Samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add TripTrack.
Xiaomi: Settings → Apps → TripTrack → turn on Autostart, and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
Huawei: Settings → Battery → App launch → TripTrack → Manage manually, with all three switches on.
